Special Educational Needs & Disabilities (SEND)
Our Offer
Mrs Wigley and Miss Stuart are the SENCO (Special Educational Needs Coordinators).
Mrs Wigley is the designated teacher for looked after and previously looked after children on both school sites.
If you wish to contact Mrs Wigley or Miss Stuart, please email the school office.
Supporting your Child's Learning
Individual Pupil Plan
An IPP (Individual Pupil Plan) is a document that helps teaching staff to plan for your child, teach them, and review their progress. It enables a child to achieve the most from their education by pinpointing areas where additional support may be required and contains targets designed to help children achieve with the curriculum.
An IPP should...
Be distributed to all relevant staff
Promote effective planning
Help pupils monitor their own progress
Result in good planning and intervention
Individual Behaviour Management Plan
IBP stands for Individual Behaviour Management Plan is a document that helps all staff to have a consistent approach to behaviour with your child, thus enabling them to achieve the most from their education.
The IBMP Should...
Be distributed to all relevant staff

School Clubs
School Clubs
A range of clubs are organised throughout the year.
Some are funded by the school, some are subsidised with a small cost, some are third party hirers.
Please keep a look out for regular communication about clubs.
Wrap around care - Woodpeckers Before and After School Club
Woodpeckers Before and After School Club
This is provided at the beginning (7.30am - 8.45am) and end of the school day (3.05pm - 5.45pm) for both Junior and Infant school children and held at the Junior school. For further information and booking please visit their website below
Funkidz Dance Club
Funkidz after school dance club held on Wednesdays. Available to both Infant and Junior children.
For further information and booking please visit their website
Rock Steady
Rock and Pop Band lessons run during the school day in the Junior schools.
For further information and booking please visit their website.
